references.text: The verse establishes a valuation system for people based on age and gender, which verse 5 continues with younger age groups.
The next age group in the valuation system, from one month to five years, showing the complete scale of value assessment.
Part of the same valuation system for persons over sixty years old, showing the full range of age-based values.
Refers to the use of the sanctuary shekel as the standard for valuation, the same monetary unit used in Leviticus 27:5.
Describes redemption money for the firstborn with value assessment in shekels, a similar principle to the valuation of persons.
Introduces the sanctuary shekel as the standard unit of measure, the same one used for value assessment in Leviticus 27.
